notes:
Venture 0.23 — the controller speaks the aircraft's announcements

• The controller now says the aircraft's own announcements out loud through the Herelink's speaker — "Starting Mission Copy", "Mission Copy Complete", "Lens Cap Detected", "Cannot upload while flying" and the rest. The Volume page under Configuration → Controller sets how loud they are. Only the aircraft's announcements are spoken in this release; the flight controller's own messages still go to the status log silently.

• In the status log those announcements are marked "Core:" so they are not mistaken for something the flight controller said, and progress lines such as a copy finishing no longer show red or count on the alerts badge. Only faults do.

• Update the controller before the aircraft, never the other way round. The announcements travel on a new message. Against an aircraft still on the older proxy they arrive the old way — in the status log, not spoken — which is fine. But an aircraft on the new proxy talking to a controller older than 0.23 announces nothing at all.

Installing over the top keeps your missions and settings.
